pairs.question: Quorsum istaec?
pairs.answer: De te mihi ad te sermo est, vir efficacissime.
pairs.derivation: Sidonius attributes the question to his addressee and answers it himself. Dropped the speech tag 'inquis' that follows 'quorsum istaec' (framing/narration of the asking). The answer stops at the first full stop after 'vir efficacissime'; the following relative clause 'cui debet respublica quod supra dictis solutum laudat historia' elaborates rather than answering the 'why am I telling you this' question. Capitalized 'Quorsum' and 'De'; otherwise verbatim.
